emergency_arrivals.description: Daily count of ambulatory and ambulance patient arrivals at emergency triage.
emergency_arrivals.missing_data_handling: Forward fill strictly prior to t; warmup window dropped
emergency_arrivals.primary_operational_use: Triage staffing, surge beds, ED boarder mitigation

admissions.description: Daily count of patients admitted from ED and elective blocks to acute inpatient beds.
admissions.primary_operational_use: General ward bed turnover, discharge planning

icu_admissions.description: Daily count of high-acuity admissions requiring mechanical ventilation or intensive monitoring.
icu_admissions.primary_operational_use: Critical care ventilator capacity and 1:1 nurse staffing

bed_occupancy.description: Total midnight census across general inpatient and intensive care units.
bed_occupancy.primary_operational_use: Hospital capacity ceiling monitoring (85% safe threshold)

supply_consumption.description: Daily burn rate of personal protective equipment, medications, and clinical supplies.
supply_consumption.primary_operational_use: Supply chain replenishment and stockout prevention
